question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
-- Final answer: Top 3 bowlers who conceded the most runs in a single over 
-- among overs that were the maximum runs in their respective match
WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.bowler,
        b.innings_no,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
),
over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        over_id,
        bowler,
        innings_no,
        SUM(total_runs) as runs_in_over
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, bowler, innings_no
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(runs_in_over) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
qualifying_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        orr.match_id,
        orr.over_id,
        orr.bowler,
        orr.innings_no,
        orr.runs_in_over,
        mrm.max_runs
    FROM over_runs orr
    JOIN max_runs_per_match mrm ON orr.match_id = mrm.match_id
    WHERE orr.runs_in_over = mrm.max_runs
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT 
        q.bowler,
        MAX(q.runs_in_over) as max_runs_conceded
    FROM qualifying_overs q
    GROUP BY q.bowler
    ORDER BY max_runs_conceded DESC, q.bowler ASC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    bm.bowler,
    p.player_name,
    bm.max_runs_conceded,
    q.match_id
FROM bowler_max bm
JOIN qualifying_overs q ON bm.bowler = q.bowler AND bm.max_runs_conceded = q.runs_in_over
JOIN player p ON bm.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bm.max_runs_conceded DESC, bm.bowler ASC;
